orders.title: Rekindle the Brazier
orders.blurb: Twenty Gem Shards, Keeper. My brazier has been cold since the last keeper fled — light it, and I shall give you something truly golden.

orders.title: Cindra’s Two Markets
orders.blurb: I keep two ledgers, Keeper. Sell me twenty gem shards for good gold — or, if your purse is heavy, forty coins buys a Gold Key outright. Your choice.

orders.title: Three Diamonds for a Key
orders.blurb: Bring me three cut diamonds, Keeper — three Flame Gems — and I shall forge you a Gold Key worthy of the deep vaults.

orders.title: Warm the Long Hearth
orders.blurb: Your little dragon keeps coughing up shards — splendid. Forge me FOUR Flame Gems and the hall will be warm by supper.

orders.title: A Centerpiece Worth the Name
orders.blurb: One Radiant Gem. ONE. Merge three Flame Gems into something that would make the old court gasp.

orders.title: The Keeper's Hoard
orders.blurb: Three Radiant Gems, Keeper. A proper hoard for a proper Keep — and proof the Flame is truly back.
